what: Alpaca half of FIX-SA-02: alpaca_live venue STOP fills are journaled exchange_flat_reconciled. MEASURED 2026-09-29 via /api/diag/alpaca_order_history: 5875 (SLV) and 6097 (IAUM) were closed 2026-09-28T13:30:03Z/13:30:02Z by their GTC OCO stop legs (filled @55.3132 vs stop 55.41, @41.2732 vs stop 41.98), yet both rows read exit_reason=exchange_flat_reconciled. Alpaca rows carry no sl_order_id (NULL on 20/20 alpaca rows since 09-15), so the reconciler cannot attribute the close. Fix: at reconcile time, look up the symbol's order history (status=closed, nested) for a filled reducing-side stop/limit leg in the close window and stamp sl/tp + exit_price from its fill.
